narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the log file.
finalText:
**`Redis` died and the service starved behind it.**

| time | event |
|---|---|
| `02:14:07` | `Redis` `10.0.0.12:6379` refused, cache off |
| `02:29:12` | queue depth 502, max 500 |
| `02:31:44` | `worker-2` `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| `02:31:52` | supervisor killed api, service down |

First bad line is [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182).

173 timeouts at `5000ms` followed the cache loss.
All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED`.
Zero requests succeeded after `02:14:07`.
This log is dated `2026-07-04`.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused.
